row.evidence: LinkedIn's Talent Solutions SSO guide says SSO "doesn't automate user management" and licenses are not revoked automatically; no SCIM documentation exists in the Recruiter help centre.
row.notes: New row. Recruiter is quote-only ("does not have a single standard price"; Recruiter plans are priced through one- to multi-year agreements via sales). SAML SSO can be set up on a Recruiter or Talent Insights contract, but LinkedIn's Talent Solutions SSO guide says SSO "doesn't automate user management" and that a departing user's license stays assigned until an Account Center admin parks, reassigns or revokes it. No SCIM is documented for Recruiter: the Recruiter help-centre search for SCIM returns no results, while SCIM is documented only for Sales Navigator and LinkedIn Learning. Okta's LinkedIn Talent Solutions app is SAML-only; Entra's app is SSO with JIT. Users can be edited in bulk via CSV in LinkedIn Admin Center. Talent APIs (Recruiter System Connect etc.) are partner programs for ATS integrations, not user management. None by absence (rule 5).

scim.notes: No SCIM documentation for Recruiter; SCIM is documented only for Sales Navigator and LinkedIn Learning.

user_api.notes: Talent API access is via partner programs (Recruiter System Connect and others) for ATS/integration partners; no customer user-management API was found.

okta.notes: OIN "LinkedIn Talent Solutions" app marks only SAML (read from page markup) even though its blurb mentions "enhanced user provisioning".

entra.notes: Entra gallery "LinkedIn Talent Solutions" is an SSO tutorial that claims JIT user provisioning; no Entra provisioning tutorial exists for it.

jumpcloud.notes: No JumpCloud integration article for LinkedIn Recruiter/Talent Solutions in the JumpCloud docs navigation.
